commits.author: rjpower
commits.message:
[skyrl] Make HF export opt-in and move RNO2A outputs to US-EAST-08A (#10825)

SkyRL launches no longer export Hugging Face checkpoints unless the
launcher
sets `run.export_hf`. When export is enabled, `hf_save_interval`
defaults to
-1, so only the terminal checkpoint gets an export request. A positive
interval still requests exports at intermediate checkpoints, and
`export_hf_checkpoint.py` still exports any checkpoint on demand.

Before this change the vendored launcher enabled export by default and
`hf_save_interval` defaulted to `ckpt_interval`, so every checkpoint
wrote an
`hf_export_request.json`. Pruning keeps every checkpoint whose export is
incomplete, and only the terminal export runs automatically.
Intermediate
checkpoints, about 1.3 TB each for a 67B policy with optimizer state,
therefore accumulated past `max_ckpts_to_keep`. Launchers that set
`hf_save_interval` to `max_steps` for terminal-only export no longer
need to.

The `cw-rno2a` task environment now writes durable outputs to
`s3://marin-us-east-08a/marin` and no longer sets `MARIN_TEMP_PREFIX`,
so
scratch and node-health probes use the shared CoreWeave temp bucket in
US-EAST-08A. Controller state and Finelog archives stay in
`marin-us-east-02a`. The new prefixes take effect when the `cw-rno2a`
controller is redeployed. Outputs written under `s3://marin-rno2a/marin`
since #10436 stay there.

commits.author: rjpower
commits.message:
Disable MPTCP on the Loom host and Caddy (#10823)

Disable MPTCP in the Loom host and Caddy network namespaces and set
`GODEBUG=multipathtcp=0` for Caddy. Persist the settings across VM
startup and proxy recreation, and document how to recreate Caddy without
restarting Loom sessions.
